season_phase.label: PRESEASON PRIOR
season_phase.note: No 2026 regular-season games have been played. Every projection rests on prior-season usage and efficiency, depth charts, role priors and the availability tables — not on current-season performance. Confidence is capped accordingly (data quality ~0.4). Weights shift to current-season data as games are played (MODEL_CARD §2).

bracket.note: MOST LIKELY PLAYOFF PATH — a representative bracket built from the simulated seed probabilities and advanced with opponent-conditional win probabilities (higher seed at home, Super Bowl neutral). All playoff/conference/Super Bowl percentages elsewhere come from the full Monte Carlo, which simulates every possible field, matchup and upset.

sb_card.note: most likely pairing from the full matchup distribution; the score is the expected margin around the measured league scoring average

season_detail.game_note: game outcomes shown are the current highest-probability result for each matchup; season record distributions come from all Monte Carlo simulations, never from counting >50% games

season_sim.game_prob_source: stored per-game Monte Carlo p_home where available (current scenario), else power-rating probit from the production game model
season_sim.convergence_note: half-split diff on playoff/Super Bowl probabilities; >1.5pp flags an under-sampled run

calibration.note: calibrated fields (p_playoffs_calibrated, p_division_calibrated) come from the walk-forward-validated Platt correction; raw simulation probabilities remain canonical and are always shown

confidence.definition: probability = share of simulations where the event happens; confidence = how stable that number is to Monte Carlo sampling, random seeds and rating uncertainty. A probability can be high while confidence is low, and vice versa.

model_changelog.reason: product visibility: surface the already-validated season simulation publicly; no probability changes
model_changelog.validation: 202 tests; Playwright at 1440/1280/800/412/390 with zero JS errors and zero horizontal overflow; backend invariants for schedule locking and bracket matchup rules

model_changelog.measured_effect: not applicable — presentation-only release; no model output changed (verified by the unchanged simulation document schema and by out of sample metrics carrying over from the v0.8.1 walk-forward audit)

models_affected: player games-played hazards (role-conditioned for projected starters)

model_changelog.pipeline_changed: futures sanity/calibration/stress-test audit (store/audits/futures_audit.json; Admin → Futures Health); Platt calibration applied to playoffs/division as ADDITIONAL labelled fields (raw simulation probabilities preserved and canonical); role-conditioned availability hazards for projected starters (models/availability_hazards_role.json); per-run input snapshots (ratings, QB availability) so movement is attributed to recorded input diffs; strict per-simulation probability-mass invariant tests; futures confidence block separate from probability
model_changelog.reason: audit pass on v0.8.0: promote only corrections that improved held-out performance; no public feature changes
model_changelog.validation: walk-forward 2019-2025, leave-season-out: playoffs Brier 0.13822→0.13718 and log-loss 0.4162→0.41174 (4/7 folds, week-1 subset also better); division Brier 0.11593→0.11557 and log-loss 0.3605→0.35884 (3/7 folds, week-1 subset also better); top-seed/conference/SB failed the criterion and stay raw. Role-conditioned hazards: games-played MAE 2.69→2.56 (better in 5/5 held-out seasons), stat MAE 179.6→167.7, milestone Brier 0.1689→0.1663; 80% interval coverage 0.560 vs 0.554 (a wash). 33 futures tests incl. 8 new.
model_changelog.expected_effect: playoffs/division headline figures flatten toward the middle (e.g. a raw 94% playoffs shows ~88% calibrated); established starters gain ~1.5 expected games vs the pooled chain; weekly prop probabilities untouched
model_changelog.measured_effect: walk-forward, leave-season-out (out of sample): playoffs Brier -0.00104 and division Brier -0.00036 vs raw; games-played MAE -0.14 games, stat MAE -11.9, milestone Brier -0.0026 vs the pooled hazard — full tables in store/audits/futures_audit.json
model_changelog.rollback: 0.8.0 (delete models/futures_calibration.json and models/availability_hazards_role.json to disable both layers)

model_changelog.pipeline_changed: actual-to-date + remaining-MC season distributions per player market; milestones; leader ranks; SB matchup matrix; convergence + reproducibility metadata; append-only futures snapshots + movement; simulate-season --if-new-finals in game-day/game-week/grade groups; data/futures.json lazy payload; per-source odds states; recovered-workflow semantics
model_changelog.reason: Futures redesigned into a season forecasting center; weekly prop platform untouched
model_changelog.validation: 207 tests incl. 25 new (locking, playoff identities, tiebreak, matchups, reproducibility, guard, snapshots, identity gate, QB effect, status semantics); walk-forward 2019-2025 backtest: shrunk ratings beat baseline on 4/5 metrics (store/backtests/season_sim.json)
model_changelog.expected_effect: none on weekly prop probabilities; season futures now published per player market
model_changelog.measured_effect: walk-forward 2019-2025 backtest (out of sample by construction): shrunk-ratings arm exp-wins MAE 1.47 vs 1.63 baseline, division/conference/SB Brier all better; playoff Brier 0.139 vs 0.135 — table in MODEL_CARD.md
